people.name: Ramathites
people.line: People from Ramah who tended King David's vineyards

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Overseer of King David's vineyards from Ramah.

people.name: Shiphmites
people.line: People from Siphmoth who oversaw David's vineyards.

people.name: Zabdi
people.line: Overseer of King David's wine cellars

translations.web: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite; and over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite;
translations.bsb: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.
translations.kjv: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
translations.asv: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: and over the increase of the vineyards for the wine-cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
